label: verify-t1-reporter-lay

claims.claim: Within the 10 RBS-only gate pairs in the Cello E. coli table, max relative steepness difference is 0.1587 while K differs by up to 7.7 times.
claims.source_says: PAIR BM3R1 B1 vs B2 n 3.4 2.9 K 0.04 0.15 dn=0.1587 Kfold=3.750; PAIR PhlF P1 vs P3 n 4.0 4.2 K 0.03 0.23 dn=0.0488 Kfold=7.667 (10 PAIR lines)
claims.note: Re-ran facts.py: file sha256 matches, 10 pairs, max dn 0.1587, max Kfold 7.667; RBS-only status relies on the agent's parts.py, which I did not re-run.

claims.claim: With shared floor, ceiling and steepness one curve is the other slid on a log-input axis; but ymax also differs between RBS variants, so the slide is only approximate.
claims.source_says: max abs diff over 10000 random trials (equal ymax,ymin,n): 8.88e-16; P1_PhlF ymax 3.9, P2 4.1, P3 6.8; B1 0.5, B3 0.8
claims.note: Algebra reproduces and the shipped table does show ymax varying across RBS variants.

claims.claim: The test's pass/fail lines (0.25, 0.40, 6.0, r>=0.80) are the designer's proposals, not yet frozen; the held-out library has not been opened.
claims.source_says: dn <= 0.25; any single pair dn > 0.40; S ... at least 6.0; Pearson r ... below 0.80 (all in design-reporter frozen_predictions; plan says freeze happens at a future commit)
claims.note: The numbers and their proposal status are in the design file; that the holdout is unopened is the agent's own statement and I could not check it.

claims.claim: The law registry has no theorem for this: gene-regulatory-dynamics is a placeholder in law set 1.8.1.
claims.source_says: "version": "1.0.0", "class": "gap", "status": "proposed", "lean_ref": {"module": null, "theorem": null ...}; lawset-1.8.1.json lists it; current.json version 1.8.1
claims.note: Registry entry is an unformalised gap placeholder; absence of any other relevant law was not exhaustively checked.

overall: All four key claims hold. The pair statistics reproduce exactly. The registry placeholder reads as stated. The one hedge is that the design file contains the 0.25, 0.40, 6.0 and r>=0.80 proposals, but the unopened-holdout statement rests on the agent's own word.
